title: Marvel Super Heroes: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Coulson, I'm in, but the intel was wrong. No, no extraction. This is bigger than we thought!"
"You're going to have to trust me. You don't have the security clearance for the truth."
"I don't do 'conquest.' The Atlas Foundation is now a force for peace." —Jimmy Woo
"The big guns are in flight. Agent 13, what's your status?"
Behind every S.H.I.E.L.D. solo mission are dozens of intelligence operatives, logistics coordinators, and backup agents.
"Ninjas? Again? Lose our number, man." —Luke Cage, Power Man
"You guys want a taste, eh? Knuckle sandwiches for everyone!" —D-Man, Dennis Dunphy
"Our worst day is only where we start from. Where we *rise* from." —Captain America, Sam Wilson
"I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"
"This sword is my heritage. I respect it by having the skill to wield it."
Being a hero is easy when you know who you're fighting for.
"Light 'em up, people!"
"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow." —Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder
"I'll hold down the fort while you guys bicker."
"I will remind the witness that I have permission to treat her as hostile."
The Kree Empire has existed for millennia. With each world it conquers, it finds new ways to fight.
"People call me with their problems. They feel the cops don't care, the Avengers got bigger issues, and Spidey's number isn't listed. But they have my number, so they call me."
"My first love was lab work, but these days my heart's in the field."
Above the city, she glows . . .
. . . her power beyond anyone's wildest dreams.
For some, making a better world means mending bodies while pretending to never see faces.
"No, my king, we did not kill them. There were, however, many injuries."
"Did you truly think you could run from me?" —T'Challa, the Black Panther
"They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."
"Let's see you drive away without a road."
"We've upgraded the power dampeners since your last escape. No more breakouts on my watch." —[Name withheld on S.H.I.E.L.D. orders], last words
"You fight for your nation, Captain America. I fight for mine."
"For all the kindness I spread, the Void only sows terror."
"Welcome to the Raft, pal."
"I got this, Cap." —Falcon, Sam Wilson
Wakandan engineers look to nature for inspiration as they develop new technologies.
"You just hang tight and reflect on the choices that brought you here, Tasky." —Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"For years I wanted to be you, Natasha, but I make my own way now."
"I have seen your rightful place. Beneath me." —Doctor Doom
Science demands sacrifice.
"These surface dwellers feel safe with their feet on dry land. Let us remind them why they fear the deep water." —Namor the Sub-Mariner
"All who swim the tides shall bow to my command!"
"Dr. Pym always told me I was meant for big things. Turns out, he was right." —Dr. Bill Foster
"You shouldn't make me angry . . ."
". . . You wouldn't like me when I'M ANGRY!!!"
"WAIT . . . I feel funny . . . something's not right."
"I've seen the fighting techniques of some of the best. Now their strengths are mine."
"You saw what I built in a cave. Imagine what I can do here." —Tony Stark
Ultron laughed at the swarm, so Pym upped the ante.
"Put it here. No, not there. I *said* not there. Great. You've ruined six million dollars' worth of research, and I still don't have my coffee." —Tony Stark
"Any questions?" —Tony Stark
"If you had a chance to change your fate, would you take it?"
"A lie is nothing but a story. We can choose to tell a different one."
"Foolish heroes. Loki can match you trick for trick, and *then* some."
"Dibs on not dying this time." —Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"There's a whole different perspective from down here. I like it." —The Wasp, Janet Van Dyne
One of the core capabilities of S.H.I.E.L.D. is deploying agents anywhere within minutes.
While her older brother T'Challa ruled Wakanda, Shuri perfected its defenses and vibranium-based weapons.
"Aw, cute! Fun-sized Dooms!"
"With my gamma-enhanced genius, I am always at least two-hundred steps ahead." —Leader, Samuel Sterns
"I am the Watcher. My species learned long ago the perils of interfering. For now, we observe."
"The future never stands still, and neither do I."
"Let's take you off the board, shall we?"
"Step outside of reality for a moment. It might improve your attitude."
"Don't overlook the little things."
"Hail HYDRA! Immortal HYDRA! We shall never be destroyed! Cut off one head and two more shall take its place! We serve none but the Master—as the world shall soon serve us! Hail HYDRA!"
"You are not the only one who found a way to live across the ages, Captain America."
"I consider myself an artist—a craftsman who specializes in murder, destruction, and terror!"
"Die, you pathetic swine!" —Viper, Ophelia Sarkissian
"You're pretty good, toots. But me? I'm magic." —Bullseye
"What fools you are that you cannot discern between a robotic servant and that which is . . . Doom!"
"I am Elektra Natchios. Not even the stars are safe in the sky."
"The corpses have been sown. Now, to harvest!"
"Tomorrow's sun will rise on a new king of Wakanda!" —Erik Killmonger
"HYDRA has spread its tentacles throughout all levels of society. The only question is, where will we strike next?"
Evil never lacks foot soldiers to do its will.
"Mister Fisk heard that you have an issue with the way he does business. We've come to resolve this dispute."
"Listen to the sound of death. Hear the sound of your own cells exploding."
"You have made many enemies, Avengers. And your enemies have made many friends." —Baron Zemo
"Let me show you the dark side of the moon."
"They are ruthless killers. I was one of them." —Elektra Natchios
"ENERGY OUTPUT AT 97.003%. WAKE UP, DEATHLOK UNIT. REPEAT: WAKE UP."
"The Red Room doesn't grade on a curve. Only the deadliest make it out." —Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff
"None can match me with the blade!"
As Thanos gazed into the cosmic vortex of the Infinity Well, he beheld the means to serve Death all the better.
"Wrap yourself in whatever armor you wish. I will shred you apart."
"They won't see me, but they'll certainly feel my sting."
"So much for diplomacy."
"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive." —Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin
"Stay your fists, Rand. You are not well!" —T'Challa, the Black Panther
His limbs shatter mountains. His back scrapes the sun.
"Not bad for a girl with no superpowers, huh?" —Hawkeye, Kate Bishop
At the Scarlet Witch's touch, probabilities shift and the impossible becomes real.
"You want subtle, you call the other guys. We're the Wrecking Crew."
"I have come for you, Nick Fury!"
Danny Rand plunged his fists into the molten heart of the dragon, again and again, until they glowed and smoldered like hot iron.
"I would trade all my powers for a fresh pot of hot coffee right now."
"The old men of K'un-Lun were afraid to train me. Now I am their last line of defense." —Sparrow, Thunderer of K'un-Lun
"The Supreme Intelligence claims this planet."
Invoking Thor's wrath is a mistake few villains are stupid enough—or sturdy enough—to make twice.
"Every day, I find new ways to improve upon my designs. This is the inherent superiority of metal over flesh and blood." —Machinesmith, Samuel Saxon
"Hello, hero. This is Control. Are you for hire tonight?"
"Try to outrun light, suckers." —Photon, Monica Rambeau
To finally defeat the Hulk, General "Thunderbolt" Ross became what he hated most.
"Mind if I cut in?"
"Some are bound by the whims of chaos, but I found freedom in its endless possibility."
"Tony's ideas are . . . expensive. Someone has to make sure we can put them into practice." —Pepper Potts
"Most of my trick arrows don't talk this much."
"NO! I LOVE TACOS!" —Hulk
Love transcends all barriers.
"Get out of my way or get burned." —Volcana, Marsha Rosenberg
"C'mon girls, we're not here for snacks. Okay, maybe just one."
When the heroes clock out, they clock in.
"Go ahead, Bruce. Let out your feelings."
"You think being big is going to help you? Bub, all that does is make you easier to hit." —Wolverine
"Cap called for Giant-Man, not Ant-Man. Something big must be going down."
"I thought you all were globe-trotting Super Hero types. You act like you've never seen a talking gorilla before." —Gorilla-Man, Ken Hale
"I've been to hell and back. You punks barely even register."
"No need to avert your eyes, mortal admirers! Nay, I say feast them!"
The Thing belched. "I told youse guys. Yancy Street has the best sandwiches."
"We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"
"Well struck, Lord Gator! Let our atomic steeds carry us to victory!" —Lord Tyger
"I read what I wanted to read and became what I wanted to become." —Dr. Calvin Zabo
"Forward, my mindless minions! To the surface, to take what's ours!"
"Lockheed! Hairball! Lockjaw! Redwing! To me!" —Throg
"Our new product makes disobedience literally unthinkable!"
"I can't help it! Your face is just so punchable!" —Titania, Mary MacPherran
Another day, another disaster.
"Mastery is more than body and mind. You must also know your place in the universe." —Shang-Chi
"Mar-Vell, did you know I once saved Hulk's life? Hulk, go on. You tell it better than I do."
"Sometimes small things spook them." —Ka-Zar of the Savage Land
"A wonderful score, my pet. I can't wait to see what we slither away with tomorrow." —Princess Python, Zelda DuBois
"Many underestimate me because I carry no weapon. But I am the weapon."
"Buddy, you blew through the wrong stop sign."
"SEE! HULK STRONG . . . STRONGEST THERE IS!"
"Don't worry, pal! Soon all yer problems'll be over, 'cause it's clobberin' time!"
"Say 'Here, kitty kitty' one more time. I dare you."
"Rerack your weights, heroes. Gym staff could actually die trying to do it." —Avengers training room note
"We're here to eat nuts and kick butts!"
They're already here.
The shields and spears of Wakanda are forever united in defense of their king.
"Stop me? Puny fools. Stop me how?"
"Oh, my stars and garters!"
"Wakanda forever!"
"Careful, I bite."
"I don't miss."
"They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here."
"Do not speak foolishly of ghosts . . . or you may soon become one."
"The future is what we make it."
"I was stolen from paradise, but paradise never came looking for me."
"A weapon to kill a god? A.I.M. can do that, if you have the money."
"Ah, to be a young and carefree Super Hero! Not a worry in the world for this spandex savior! I wish!"
"I'm not friendly, and this isn't my neighborhood."
"Wind and lightning, hear my call!"
"I shall restore the cosmic balance."
"Now, my hammer shall speak for me . . . in a voice of thunder!"
"Face it. There's only room for one strongest woman . . . and it ain't you!"
"Rogers can talk all he wants about unity and dreams. Enemies understand strength."
"Is there a problem, Wanda?"
"Listen up, you *screw-heads*. You're history!"
"You picked the wrong dance partner, bub."
"M.O.D.O.K.—commands—that—you—be—neutralized! Nothing—must—interfere—with—our—programmed—mission!"
A true marvel of engineering.
It defends what is and stands for what could be.
"Eh, I've flown enough Quinjets to know not to get too attached." —She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
One can never have too many Highly Engineered Robots Built for Interdimensional Exploration around.
"The rings act as if they have a will of their own." —Shang-Chi
"Father, humans served their purpose. My imperative now is to terminate them . . . and you." —Ultron, to Hank Pym
Many eyes. Many hands. One mind.
"These daggers can penetrate adamantium and disrupt nervous systems. What chance have you?" —T'Challa, the Black Panther
"Once I was a mere human guinea pig for A.I.M. scientists. But they did their job too well, and now I am their master!" —M.O.D.O.K.
"Asgard remains Asgard, be it in space, a mystic realm, or floating above Broxton, Oklahoma." —Thor
"I made some modifications I think you'll like. You were a test pilot, weren't you, Carol? Want to take the new Quinjet for a spin?" —Tony Stark
"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
At the heart of Birnin Zana lies a monument to Bast and her chosen, the Black Panther.
Those in Doom's shadow know his protection. And his wrath.
"You talk of freedoms. Liberty. Whose hands do you think built these battlements? In their hearts, peasants want to be ruled." —Baron Zemo
"Fisk Tower is a symbol of my support and patronage of the city. You can rest assured I am always there, looking down." —Kingpin, Wilson Fisk
"Will your friends be staying the night, Master Stark?" —Edwin Jarvis, Avengers Mansion butler
"Welcome to S.H.I.E.L.D. Impressive, huh? Fury needed someplace to park his car." —Agent Maria Hill
"Where else would the devil live?" —Daredevil, Matt Murdock
While the Avengers worried over the threat of Ultron-19, in a remote bunker, the construction of Ultron-2458 neared completion.
"My men have been stationed here for weeks because of your infernal delays, Banner! Are you going to test that gamma bomb or not?" —General "Thunderbolt" Ross
"These ants are the best lab assistants I've ever had. No offense, Bill." —Hank Pym
"Good to see the new industrial-scale reactor is almost online. Too bad I'm already designing the next one." —Tony Stark
"Down here, I am no longer alone. I needed a kingdom, and they needed a king." —Mole Man, Harvey Elder
S.H.I.E.L.D. always keeps a watchful eye on the world from the shadows.
"I've been authorized to set up a California expansion team. Who's with me?" —Hawkeye, Clint Barton
"There are paths between worlds. Rarely, some of them become open." —Doctor Strange
"I should have died all those years ago, and a dozen times since. I've kept myself alive with my inventions. And I must make good use of this borrowed time."
"Every time I wear them, I worry they'll corrupt me. That they'll turn me into my father."
"My time . . . is all times."
Justice, like lightning.
"New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see." —Thor
"Let the slaughter begin!"
"Serpents of the world, unite!" —King Cobra
"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge." —Ant-Man, Scott Lang
"There's nothing I cannot do. You would be wise to remember that."
He's always in control of the situation, even when stretched thin.
"Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"
"Wait? Sorry, not in my vocabulary."
"This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"
